custom_expected: Either: (a) System roles show NO three-dot menu (only eye icon) so Delete is unreachable. Or: (b) Three-dot menu exists but does not include Delete. Or: (c) Delete exists but is disabled/greyed-out. In ALL cases the system role CANNOT be deleted.
custom_preconds: On Roles & Permissions list. At least one system role row visible (e.g., Service Manager).
custom_steps:
1. Locate the Service Manager row.
  2. Look at the Actions column.
  3. If a three-dot menu is present, click it. Look for Delete option.
  4. If Delete is present, click it. Observe response.
title: System role cannot be deleted — three-dot menu does not expose Delete OR Delete is disabled
